New XC40 · New EX40 · New XC60 · XC90 long range · September 2026

The Road Ahead studios hosted 241 journalists and creators, and the coverage that followed reached a potential 303 million people.

For 20 days before the embargoes lifted, virtual production studios in London and Gothenburg welcomed guests from more than 35 countries to film the new Volvos. Their work led the press, social and video coverage of both launches.

Prepared by Studio One for Volvo CarsData to 15 October 2026
The studios

London and Gothenburg hosted 241 guests over 20 days, right up to the embargoes

198 sessions ran between 24 August and 12 September. North American media came first, then Europe market by market, with Latin America, the Nordics and emerging markets in between. UK lifestyle creators filmed on 3 and 4 September. London kept filming after the XC40 and EX40 embargo lifted on 10 September at 09:00.

Reach

The XC60 and XC90 launch reached 168 million people in five days, beyond the 135 million for the XC40 and EX40 in seven

Volvo's Cision reports measured the first seven days of the XC40 and EX40 launch and the first five of the XC60 and XC90 long range. Across both, 1,132 articles and 1,521 social posts went out. 98% of XC40 and EX40 press coverage was positive or factual, and 99% for the XC60 and XC90.

Four cars

All four cars grew in September, and the XC90 grew faster than the XC60 it launched beside

Meltwater counted mentions of each model across news, YouTube, Reddit, X, forums and blogs. The EX40 more than doubled. The XC90 long range shared its launch with the XC60 and still rose 63% to 13,900 mentions, its best day on 15 September, embargo day.

The EX40 grew 110%, the XC40 80% and the XC90 63%

August against September, by model

Daily product sessions on volvocars.com rose to four times normal for the XC60

Volvo's figures: a normal day before launch against the launch peak

After the peak, XC40 and EX40 sessions settled at about 19,000 a day, around half as much again as before launch.

Competitors

Volvo's share of conversation rose against every competitor set in launch month

We compared September mentions with August for each Volvo and its closest German rivals, on the same Meltwater sources. Volvo gained share in all four sets. Press made the same comparisons: Cision found the XC60 set most often against the Mercedes GLC, the XC90 against the BMW X5 and the XC40 against the BMW X1 and Audi Q3.

    What comes next

    The Road Ahead studio can become Volvo's standing creator base for the next model moments

    The studios showed that media and creators from every region will come in, make strong work and carry it to their audiences on embargo day. These are the ways to build on it.

    01

    Build measurement into the studio from day one

    Give each guest a tracked link and a short post launch form, and keep one content log by guest, market and car. Agree the key messages up front so every car gets a pickup score. Joined with Volvo's paid media and volvocars.com data, that would give a full launch picture, including return on investment, within days of embargo.

    02

    Give the best guest content a longer life

    Autogefühl, Sean Chandler, What Car?, Izzy Hammond and the UK lifestyle creators made work that beat their usual numbers. With their agreement, these pieces are ready made assets for the order window.

    03

    Bring the YouTube reviewers back for long form

    YouTube carried the most watched launch content, and six of the top ten videos came from studio guests. A second session for drive reviews would extend the run.

    04

    Send the cars home for a second wave

    A week with the car lets creators show the electric school run, what 200 km of range means day to day, and Google built in. Carl Thompson's XC60 school run reel shows the format.

    05

    Give the EX40 and XC90 their own stories

    Both grew fastest in their pairs while sharing the stage. Electric only content for the EX40 and a long range family story for the XC90 would build on that.

    06

    Grow the US guest list

    US titles carried 41% to 58% of press audience from 46 North American guests. More US creators in the studio would follow the audience.

    07

    Cut TikTok first edits in the same session

    Izzy Hammond and Jonas Autovlog showed what native TikTok content can do. Shoot vertical cuts made for the platform while guests are on set.

    08

    Book the next sessions around real moments

    EX60 deliveries, the next model year updates and the March 2027 UK plate change are natural next dates for the set.

Potential audience is the combined audience of outlets and accounts that published. A creator's usual reel is the median of their other recent reels.
